Compatibility build of decode-uri-component 0.5.0 (Sam Verschueren, MIT). Source: official npm tarball, shasum 4592fa1e1d640ec5e2760e2e168ad2ab5f2c9da1. Two documented changes: replace the default ESM export with module.exports for Expo Router’s query-string 7 CommonJS caller; replace user-sized regular-expression compilation in the fallback replacement loop with literal split/join, preventing a large malformed URI from exceeding the regex engine’s limit. The upstream UTF-8 decoding algorithm and original MIT notice are preserved. This fixes GHSA-vcc3-ghjq-m6fr without changing Expo SDK or query-string major version. Reassess when the supported Expo release includes the upstream fix.
